Played from 3 to 18 December, the knockout stage ended with the final, held at Lusail Stadium in Lusail, Qatar between Argentina and France. The top two teams from each group advanced to the knockout stage to compete in a single-elimination tournament. There were 16 matches in the knockout stage, including a match for third place played between the two losing teams of the semi-finals. It was hosted by Poland. It was the second time that Poland had hosted a FIFA tournament, having hosted the men's FIFA U-20 World Cup in 2019. It was the first time that Poland had hosted a FIFA women's tournament. Spain were crowned champions, their second title in this tournament. North Korea were the defending champions, having won a joint-record third title in 2024, but lost to Spain in the final.
